# React Native SDK Setup Guide

Source: https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-react-native

The Linkzly React Native SDK is a TypeScript wrapper over the native iOS and Android SDKs. It tracks installs, opens, and custom events; handles Universal Links (iOS) and App Links (Android), including deferred deep linking; captures affiliate click IDs and stores them so your server can use them for server-to-server (S2S) conversion tracking; supports SKAdNetwork and ATT on iOS; integrates Firebase Cloud Messaging for push; and exposes a gaming event pipeline.

The package is `@linkzly/react-native-sdk`, has zero JavaScript dependencies, and ships with full TypeScript types. It is a native module, so it does not run in Expo Go.
